body: VS1: per-Field-Office Watcher alertness (claims +15, contests +25, flips +15, nearby PvP +10, decays -5/30s); at alertness >=65 a 2-mob Enforcement squad spawns and targets the FO owner if online/nearby (real vanilla Mob#setTarget AI, confirmed against the actual paper-api-26.2 jar's Pathfinder/MobGoals classes before writing code, not guessed). IDUNA integration: new GTA7-SERVER agent, IdunaClient replaces VS0's CLI-shell-out with direct HTTP auth+Apple-posting. WOTAN integration: every joining player registered into IDUNA's real player registry (provider=minecraft), same identity system REDGARDEN-BOTS uses. All verified end-to-end via curl before Java was written, and the plugin boots clean with zero exceptions on the live server. Real gameplay (claim/contest/enforcement/join-linking) not yet exercised by a real connected client.
title: VS1 + IDUNA/WOTAN integration live
